registers.name: Emotional
registers.desc: Speaking AS the brand. Confident, direct, peer-to-peer, crescendo cadence (short punch, then build). Carries a claim, position, or promise.

registers.name: Receipts
registers.desc: Proof FOR the brand. Cold fact, specifically named, sourced or dated. Numbers, credentials, signed partnerships.

registers.name: Informational
registers.desc: Reporting ABOUT the brand. Plain, third-person, factual. Documents how something works.

note: A post can mix registers, but each sentence should know which one it is in. When precision and voice conflict on an earned brand phrase, voice wins; do not strip an earned phrase to pass a literal slop check.
